reviews.title: There are better options.
reviews.text: Hopeless. The pay option pops up immediately. If I wanted to pay for a subscription, I would choose Tidal or Spotify. That's how it is. I understand that the creator often wants payment for creating the application or decides to benefit from advertising.  But let it be a one-time payment.  What's more, after 10 seconds, a request for a rating pops up. To rate it, you have to try it out.
